messages:
jake: deploy-bot flagged a canary p95 jump for v3.6.0 (around 600ms). We have Dedicated routes in play. Recommend holding auto-revert and doing a targeted canary rollback.

deploy-bot: Auto-revert threshold reached: p95 > 500ms for 3m. Suggested action: revert to 3.5.2.

tara: I agree with targeted rollback. Auto will affect Dedicated customers if allowed. Can we suppress auto for 15m?

ops-bot: @tara hold placed: suppressing auto-rollback for 15 minutes.

jake: Plan: 1) rollback canary slice to 3.5.2; 2) pin dedicated routes to 3.5.2; 3) send short CS note; 4) triage kernel/quant path.

tara: I'll run the rollback and pin. Commands:
``
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=inference --to-version=3.5.2 --slice=canary --reason="post-canary latency"
redwoodctl routes pin --route=dedicated-apac --version=3.5.2
``

ops-bot: ACTION: tara initiated rollback at 2026-04-05T14:12:05Z. Job id: rb-4639001112-a

tara: Canary rollback complete; running smoke.

tara: Smoke: p95 down to 110ms, no 502s. Dashboards look healthy.

jake: Sending CS note now. We'll keep canary pinned for 30m then reevaluate. Open post-mortem ticket and include kernel selections.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback recorded. Recommendation: revert kernel selector change in next candidate.

jake: Thanks. Closing unless we see regression.
